name: agentinbox
description: Read shared IMAP mail and prepare optional SMTP messages for individual local approval.

interface.shortDescription: Your IMAP mail, with individually approved SMTP sends.
interface.longDescription: Choose mail servers and account permissions in local setup. Search and read shared mail, then review each optional outgoing message before SMTP submission. Requested mail content can reach your assistant's AI service.
defaultPrompt: Use AgentInbox to list my shared accounts and find unread mail from today.
Use AgentInbox to prepare an email for my local review. Do not send it without my approval.
